about.text: COP31 is the United Nations Climate Change Conference taking place in Antalya, Türkiye from 9 to 20 November 2026. It is the 31st meeting of the Conference of the Parties to the UN Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC), alongside CMP 21 (Kyoto Protocol), CMA 8 (Paris Agreement) and the 65th sessions of the subsidiary bodies (SBSTA 65 and SBI 65).
facts: 11–12 November, theme “Towards a Sustainable, Resilient and Equitable Future”

negotiations: Money
Who pays to help poorer countries deal with climate change?
COP30 set up a two-year work programme on what rich countries owe. Bonn could not agree how to run it, so COP31 has to.
https://whatthecop.com/negotiations/climate-finance
Adapting
How do we know if the world is protecting itself from climate impacts?
COP30 agreed 59 voluntary indicators. Bonn could not agree how to use them; COP31 picks up the unfinished text.
https://whatthecop.com/negotiations/adaptation
Workers
How do we protect workers and communities as the world moves off fossil fuels?
COP30 agreed a mechanism should exist. Bonn produced a list of possible elements; COP31 has to decide what it does and who runs it.
https://whatthecop.com/negotiations/just-transition
Cutting emissions
Should countries keep their joint programme for cutting emissions faster?
The joint programme was set up to run until 2026. Bonn could not agree whether to keep it; COP31 decides.
https://whatthecop.com/negotiations/cutting-emissions
Carbon markets
Can a country pay another to cut emissions for it?
The rules are written. COP31 looks at how they work in practice.
https://whatthecop.com/negotiations/carbon-markets
Loss and damage
Who pays when a climate disaster has already happened?
The fund exists and has opened its first call. COP31 gives it guidance; the money is far short of the requests.
https://whatthecop.com/negotiations/loss-and-damage
Checking progress
Are countries using the 2023 global check-up in their climate plans?
Each year countries check whether the 2023 stocktake shapes their plans. The next full stocktake ends in 2028.
https://whatthecop.com/negotiations/global-stocktake
Climate plans
Should there be clearer rules for what goes into national climate plans?
Common features for national plans have been postponed for years. The question is back on the agenda.
https://whatthecop.com/negotiations/climate-plans
